info.title: Muuvo Partner API
info.description: Partner API for sending tenancies, tenant leads and home buyers to Muuvo. Full guide: https://developerguide.muuvo.dev/

get.description: Returns every landlord on your account.

post.description: Create the landlord first. Keep the returned resultId as the landlordId for the property.

put.description: Send the full landlord record with the corrections.

get.description: Returns every property on your account, with utility and council data.

post.description: Muuvo starts matching the council, suppliers and meters as soon as the property is created.

get.description: Usually populated straight away. If the address needs manual meter matching, allow up to two hours.

put.description: Use this to correct the address or landlord rather than creating a new property.

get.description: Returns a summary of every tenancy on your account.

post.description: Send as soon as references are passed. Use the pre-tenancy builder on this page to generate this body.

get.description: Returns the tenancy, meters with readings, and tenants.

put.description: Use the stored tenancy ID for any change. Posting again would create a duplicate.

delete.description: Removes the tenancy. Landlords and properties cannot be deleted through the API.

post.description: Once the check-in inventory is done. Aim for within five days of move-in: the later the readings, the more likely billing issues become.
Call it twice. First as soon as notice is given, when the readings and forwarding address can be left empty. Then again on move-out with the closing readings and the forwarding address.
Use this if the forwarding address changes after the end of tenancy has been sent.

get.description: Returns every tenant on the tenancy.

post.description: Call once for each tenant on the tenancy.
Note this update uses POST, not PUT.

delete.description: Removes the tenant from the tenancy.

get.description: Returns every tenant lead on your account.

post.description: A tenant to offer Muuvo services to, without any council or utility notifications.

get.description: Returns one tenant lead, including utility data for the address.

put.description: Send the full lead with the corrections.

get.description: Returns every home buyer lead on your account.

post.description: A buyer from your sales side to offer Muuvo services to before they move in.

get.description: Returns one home buyer, including utility data for the address.

put.description: Send the full home buyer with the corrections.
